children: Researchers are using AI to analyze large collections of animal vocalizations for patterns that could help humans better understand how species such as crows communicate, according to Bloomberg.

Bloomberg Weekend Senior Writer Morgan Meaker said on Bloomberg This Weekend that the technology could reshape humans’ relationship with animals, while researchers warn it raises ethical questions about privacy, exploitation and how the findings might be used.

title: AI Could Change How Humans Interpret Animal Communication
